name: [BLIZZARD 2] Night Before the Blizzard
desc:
After doing Christmas shopping at the local mall, a warning about a severe storm at night goes out across town while there is a monster on the loose that no one knows anything about.

This game is all about trial and error, and that's part of the experience of learning how it works. So don't be upset that you died, be happy that you're progressing! :)

(Recommended to play this horror game with friends for a more fun and less complicated experience...)
-> Inspired by ONAF 3, Pressure and Residence Massacre <-

R - unlock mouse

Latest Update log:
- Added a skin system, you can unlock skins by buying with points or earning badges.
- Modifiers are now organized into sections.
- 6 more modifiers.
- 2 new badges and hats.
- Blizzard QOL: Enhanced map, bug fixes and way more!

Support for which devices? 
PC/Mobile/Console/VR (yes, very bad but yes)
